card.name: Hamlet, The Mopey Hound
card.power: Indecision. Flip a coin. If heads, do nothing. If tails, write a poem about doing nothing.
card.lore: O, that this too too solid flesh would melt... or at least nap.

line: Hamlet, The Mopey Hound, Indecision: heads nothing, tails poem about nothing
spokenText: Hamlet, The Mopey Hound, Indecision: heads nothing, tails poem about nothing

card.name: Claudius, The Rat King
card.power: Usurp. Swap hands with the player who has the most points.
card.lore: A brother's murder. Pray can I not. My stronger guilt defeats my strong intent.

line: Claudius, The Rat King, Usurp: swap hands; a brother's murder. Pray can I not.
spokenText: Remember Claudius, The Rat King, Usurp: swap hands; a brother's murder. Pray can I not.

card.name: Gertrude, The Poodle
card.power: Willful Ignorance. Ignore the effects of the next Action Card played against you.
card.lore: The lady doth protest too much, methinks.

line: Gertrude, The Poodle, Willful Ignorance: ignore Action; lady doth protest too much.
spokenText: Gertrude, The Poodle, Willful Ignorance: ignore Action; lady doth protest too much.

card.name: The Ghost, The Sheet
card.power: Haunt. Force an opponent to discard their highest card.
card.lore: I am thy father's spirit... doom'd for a certain term to walk the night.

line: The Ghost, The Sheet, Haunt: discard highest card; father's spirit walk the night.
spokenText: The Ghost, The Sheet, Haunt: discard highest card; father's spirit walk the night.

card.name: Polonius, The Parrot
card.power: Verbose. Talk uninterrupted for 30 seconds. If anyone interrupts, draw a card.
card.lore: Brevity is the soul of wit... and tediousness the limbs and outward flourishes.

line: Polonius, The Parrot, Verbose: talk uninterrupted; brevity is soul of wit.
spokenText: You know Polonius, The Parrot, Verbose: talk uninterrupted; brevity is soul of wit.

card.name: Ophelia, The Otter
card.power: Distraction. Sing a song. Opponents must cover their ears or lose a turn.
card.lore: Lord, we know what we are, but know not what we may be.

line: Ophelia, The Otter, Distraction: sing song; know what we are, not what we may be.
spokenText: Ophelia, The Otter, Distraction: sing song; know what we are, not what we may be.

card.name: Laertes, The Gamecock
card.power: Revenge. Deal double damage to any player who played a 'Hamlet' card.
card.lore: I dare damnation. To this point I stand... only I'll be reveng'd.

line: Laertes, The Gamecock, Revenge: double damage to Hamlet player; I dare damnation.
spokenText: Laertes, The Gamecock, Revenge: double damage to Hamlet player; I dare damnation.

card.name: Horatio, The Retriever
card.power: Witness. If you lose the game, you may narrate the winner's victory to make them feel guilty.
card.lore: Absent thee from felicity awhile... to tell my story.

line: Horatio, The Retriever, Witness, narrates winner's victory to make them feel guilty?
spokenText: What if Horatio, The Retriever, Witness, narrates winner's victory to make them feel guilty?

card.name: Yorick, The Prop
card.power: Memento Mori. All players must discard all 'Vanity' cards.
card.lore: A fellow of infinite jest... where be your gibes now?

line: Yorick, The Prop, Memento Mori: discard Vanity; infinite jest, where be your gibes?
spokenText: Yorick, The Prop, Memento Mori: discard Vanity; infinite jest, where be your gibes?

card.name: Rosencrantz & Guildenstern
card.power: Expendable. You may discard this card to avoid taking damage.
card.lore: They are not near my conscience.

line: Rosencrantz & Guildenstern, Expendable: discard to avoid damage; not near my conscience.
spokenText: Rosencrantz & Guildenstern, Expendable: discard to avoid damage; not near my conscience.

card.name: The Mousetrap Play
card.power: Guilt Trip. Look at an opponent's hand. If they have a 'King' card, they must discard it.
card.lore: The play's the thing wherein I'll catch the conscience of the King.

line: The Mousetrap Play, Guilt Trip: King card discarded; play catches King's conscience.
spokenText: Anyway, The Mousetrap Play, Guilt Trip: King card discarded; play catches King's conscience.

card.name: The Poison Cup
card.power: Accidental Death. Pass this card to the left. That player loses 5 HP.
card.lore: The drink, the drink! I am poison'd.

line: The Poison Cup, Accidental Death: pass left, lose HP; drink, I am poison'd.
spokenText: The Poison Cup, Accidental Death: pass left, lose HP; drink, I am poison'd.

card.name: Macbeth, The Hyena
card.power: Ambition. Gain +10 Power, but you cannot sleep (skip your draw phase).
card.lore: I am in blood stepp'd in so far... returning were as tedious as go o'er.

line: Macbeth, The Hyena, Ambition: Power gained, cannot sleep; blood stepp'd in so far.
spokenText: Macbeth, The Hyena, Ambition: Power gained, cannot sleep; blood stepp'd in so far.

card.name: Lady M, The Sphynx Cat
card.power: Coercion. Force another player to attack a target of your choice.
card.lore: Out, damned spot! out, I say!

line: Lady M, The Sphynx Cat, Coercion: force another to attack; out damned spot.
spokenText: No wait, Lady M, The Sphynx Cat, Coercion: force another to attack; out damned spot.

card.name: The Weird Sisters
card.power: Prophecy. Look at the top 3 cards of the deck. Arrange them to screw over your friends.
card.lore: Double, double toil and trouble; Fire burn and cauldron bubble.

line: The Weird Sisters, Prophecy: arrange cards to screw over friends; double toil and trouble.
spokenText: The Weird Sisters, Prophecy: arrange cards to screw over friends; double toil and trouble.

card.name: Banquo, The Ghost Dog
card.power: Guilt. The player with the most cards cannot play any Actions this turn.
card.lore: Thou canst not say I did it; never shake thy gory locks at me.

line: Banquo, The Ghost Dog, Guilt: most cards cannot play Actions; never shake thy gory locks.
spokenText: Banquo, The Ghost Dog, Guilt: most cards cannot play Actions; never shake thy gory locks.

card.name: Macduff, The Ram
card.power: Not Born of Woman. Defeat any card with the 'Tyrant' tag automatically.
card.lore: Macduff was from his mother's womb untimely ripp'd.

line: Macduff, The Ram, Not Born of Woman: Tyrant defeated; womb untimely ripp'd.
spokenText: Before we continue, Macduff, The Ram, Not Born of Woman: Tyrant defeated; womb untimely ripp'd.

card.name: Lady Macduff, The Bird
card.power: Innocence. If this card is destroyed, the attacker loses 10 Reputation.
card.lore: Poor bird! thou'ldst never fear the net nor lime.

line: Lady Macduff, The Bird, Innocence: attacker loses Reputation; poor bird!
spokenText: Lady Macduff, The Bird, Innocence: attacker loses Reputation; poor bird!

card.name: The Porter, The Badger
card.power: Comic Relief. Pause the game. Everyone takes a drink.
card.lore: Drink, sir, is a great provoker of three things... nose-painting, sleep, and urine.

line: The Porter, The Badger, Comic Relief: everyone drink; nose-painting, sleep, and urine.
spokenText: The Porter, The Badger, Comic Relief: everyone drink; nose-painting, sleep, and urine.

card.name: Malcolm, The Lamb
card.power: Restoration. Shuffle the discard pile back into the deck.
card.lore: Pour we in our country's purge each drop of us.

line: Malcolm, The Lamb, Restoration: discard pile back into deck; country's purge.
spokenText: Not a metaphor: Malcolm, The Lamb, Restoration: discard pile back into deck; country's purge.

card.name: The Air-Drawn Dagger
card.power: Hallucination. Reroll your attack dice. If you fail, you attack yourself.
card.lore: Is this a dagger which I see before me, the handle toward my hand?

line: The Air-Drawn Dagger, Hallucination: failed attack on yourself; dagger before me.
spokenText: The Air-Drawn Dagger, Hallucination: failed attack on yourself; dagger before me.

card.name: Birnam Wood
card.power: Camouflage. Your units cannot be targeted this turn.
card.lore: And now a wood comes toward Dunsinane.

line: Birnam Wood, Camouflage: units not targeted; wood comes toward Dunsinane.
spokenText: Birnam Wood, Camouflage: units not targeted; wood comes toward Dunsinane.

card.name: The Cauldron
card.power: Brew. Sacrifice two weak cards to summon one strong card.
card.lore: Cool it with a baboon's blood, then the charm is firm and good.

line: The Cauldron, Brew: weak cards into strong; baboon's blood, charm good.
spokenText: The thing about The Cauldron, Brew: weak cards into strong; baboon's blood, charm good.

card.name: Sleep
card.power: Insomnia. No players may 'Rest' or heal this turn.
card.lore: Macbeth does murder sleep, the innocent sleep.

line: Sleep, Insomnia: no Rest or heal; murder innocent sleep.
spokenText: Sleep, Insomnia: no Rest or heal; murder innocent sleep.

card.name: Lear, The Old Lion
card.power: Abdicate. Give half your cards to two other players. Then scream at them.
card.lore: I am a man more sinn'd against than sinning.

line: Lear, The Old Lion, Abdicate: give half cards, then scream
spokenText: Lear, The Old Lion, Abdicate: give half cards, then scream

card.name: The Fool, The Bird
card.power: Truth Bomb. Reveal an opponent's hand. Mock their strategy.
card.lore: The fool will stay, and let the wise man fly.

line: The Fool, The Bird, Truth Bomb: mock their strategy; fool will stay, wise man fly.
spokenText: Everyone agrees: The Fool, The Bird, Truth Bomb: mock their strategy; fool will stay, wise man fly.

card.name: Goneril, The Vulture
card.power: Eviction. Force a player to discard a 'Land' or 'Home' card.
card.lore: I'll not chide thee... thou art a boil, a plague sore.

line: Goneril, The Vulture, Eviction: discard Home; boil, plague sore.
spokenText: Goneril, The Vulture, Eviction: discard Home; boil, plague sore.

card.name: Regan, The Cobra
card.power: Cruelty. Select a player. That player is now 'Blind' (plays cards face down).
card.lore: Prescribe not us our duty.

line: Regan, The Cobra, Cruelty: player Blind, face-down cards; prescribe not us our duty.
spokenText: Regan, The Cobra, Cruelty: player Blind, face-down cards; prescribe not us our duty.

card.name: Gloucester, The Mole
card.power: Despair. Roll a die. If 1-3, jump off the cliff (discard hand). If 4-6, survive miraculously.
card.lore: I have no way, and therefore want no eyes.

line: Gloucester, The Mole, Despair? Jump cliff or survive; no way, want no eyes.
spokenText: Have you heard of Gloucester, The Mole, Despair? Jump cliff or survive; no way, want no eyes.

card.name: Edmund, The Fox
card.power: Bastard's Ambition. Swap your lowest card for an opponent's highest card.
card.lore: Now, gods, stand up for bastards!

line: Edmund, The Fox, Bastard's Ambition: swap lowest for highest; gods, stand up for bastards!
spokenText: Edmund, The Fox, Bastard's Ambition: swap lowest for highest; gods, stand up for bastards!

card.name: Edgar, The Mongrel
card.power: Disguise. You cannot be targeted by attacks this turn.
card.lore: Tom's acold... The foul fiend bites my back.

line: Edgar, The Mongrel, Disguise: no attacks target; foul fiend bites back.
spokenText: Edgar, The Mongrel, Disguise: no attacks target; foul fiend bites back.

card.name: Kent, The Bulldog
card.power: Bluntness. Cancel a 'Flattery' or 'Persuasion' effect.
card.lore: Sir, 'tis my occupation to be plain.

line: Kent, The Bulldog, Bluntness: cancel Flattery; occupation to be plain.
spokenText: Let me tell you about Kent, The Bulldog, Bluntness: cancel Flattery; occupation to be plain.

card.name: The Storm
card.power: Cataclysm. All players discard 1 card for every card they hold.
card.lore: Blow, winds, and crack your cheeks! rage! blow!

line: The Storm, Cataclysm: discard cards; winds crack cheeks, rage.
spokenText: The Storm, Cataclysm: discard cards; winds crack cheeks, rage.

card.name: The Stocks
card.power: Humiliation. Choose a player. They lose their next turn.
card.lore: Fortune, that arrant whore, ne'er turns the key to th' poor.

line: The Stocks, Humiliation: lose next turn; Fortune ne'er turns key to poor.
spokenText: The Stocks, Humiliation: lose next turn; Fortune ne'er turns key to poor.

card.name: The Cliff (Dover)
card.power: Placebo. Heal 5 HP even though nothing actually happened.
card.lore: Ten masts at each make not the altitude which thou hast perpendicularly fell.

line: The Cliff, Placebo: heal 5 HP, nothing actually happened; cliff altitude.
spokenText: This one has a rule: The Cliff, Placebo: heal 5 HP, nothing actually happened; cliff altitude.

card.name: Cordelia, The Dove
card.power: Tragic End. The game ends immediately. Everyone loses.
card.lore: Why should a dog, a horse, a rat, have life, and thou no breath at all?

line: Cordelia, The Dove, Tragic End: everyone loses; dog, horse, rat have life.
spokenText: Cordelia, The Dove, Tragic End: everyone loses; dog, horse, rat have life.

card.name: Cleopatra, The Peacock-Snake
card.power: Infinite Variety. Change the rules of the game for one turn.
card.lore: Age cannot wither her, nor custom stale her infinite variety.

line: Cleopatra, The Peacock-Snake, Infinite Variety: change rules; age cannot wither her.
spokenText: Cleopatra, The Peacock-Snake, Infinite Variety: change rules; age cannot wither her.

card.name: Antony, The Old War Horse
card.power: Dotage. Ignore your responsibilities. Lose 5 Defense, Gain 5 Charisma.
card.lore: The triple pillar of the world transform'd into a strumpet's fool.

line: Antony, The Old War Horse, Dotage: ignore responsibilities; triple pillar into strumpet's fool.
spokenText: Nobody warned us about Antony, The Old War Horse, Dotage: ignore responsibilities; triple pillar into strumpet's fool.

card.name: Octavius, The Shark
card.power: Bureaucracy. Tax the other players. Take 1 Gold/Token from each.
card.lore: He fishes, drinks, and wastes the lamps of night in revel.

line: Octavius, The Shark, Bureaucracy: tax players; fishes, drinks, wastes lamps.
spokenText: Octavius, The Shark, Bureaucracy: tax players; fishes, drinks, wastes lamps.

card.name: Enobarbus, The Fox
card.power: Defection. Switch teams/alliances mid-battle. Die of heartbreak later.
card.lore: The barge she sat in, like a burnish'd throne, burn'd on the water.

line: Enobarbus, The Fox, Defection: switch alliances mid-battle, die of heartbreak later.
spokenText: Enobarbus, The Fox, Defection: switch alliances mid-battle, die of heartbreak later.

card.name: Charmian & Iras, Flamingos
card.power: Fortune Telling. Predict the next card drawn. If correct, keep it.
card.lore: Let me be married to three kings in a forenoon, and widow them all.

line: Charmian & Iras, Flamingos, Fortune Telling: predict next card; three kings, widow them all.
spokenText: The deck insists on Charmian & Iras, Flamingos, Fortune Telling: predict next card; three kings, widow them all.

card.name: Lepidus, The Crocodile
card.power: Third Wheel. You exist. You do nothing effective. You are removed from the board easily.
card.lore: What manner o' thing is your crocodile?

line: Lepidus, The Crocodile, Third Wheel: nothing effective; what manner thing crocodile?
spokenText: Lepidus, The Crocodile, Third Wheel: nothing effective; what manner thing crocodile?

card.name: Eros, The Squire
card.power: Self-Sacrifice. Take damage intended for your Leader.
card.lore: Thus do I escape the sorrow of Antony's death.

line: Eros, The Squire, Self-Sacrifice: damage for Leader; escape Antony's sorrow.
spokenText: Eros, The Squire, Self-Sacrifice: damage for Leader; escape Antony's sorrow.

card.name: The Messenger
card.power: Bad News. The bearer of this card takes damage whenever a King/Queen dies.
card.lore: The nature of bad news infects the teller.

line: The Messenger, Bad News: bearer damage; bad news infects teller.
spokenText: Which brings us to The Messenger, Bad News: bearer damage; bad news infects teller.

card.name: The Asp (Baby Snake)
card.power: Quick Exit. Remove your Character from play without losing points.
card.lore: With thy sharp teeth this knot intrinsicate of life at once untie.

line: The Asp, Quick Exit: Character removed; sharp teeth untie life.
spokenText: The Asp, Quick Exit: Character removed; sharp teeth untie life.

card.name: Naval Battle (Actium)
card.power: Retreat. Flee the battle. Your reputation is destroyed.
card.lore: The greater cantle of the world is lost with very ignorance.

line: Naval Battle, Retreat: flee battle; world lost with ignorance.
spokenText: Naval Battle, Retreat: flee battle; world lost with ignorance.

card.name: The Monument
card.power: Siege. You cannot be attacked for 2 turns, but you cannot attack either.
card.lore: Lock yourself, and send him word you are dead.

line: The Monument, Siege? Cannot attack or be attacked; lock yourself, word you are dead.
spokenText: Do you know The Monument, Siege? Cannot attack or be attacked; lock yourself, word you are dead.

card.name: Excessive Wine
card.power: Debauchery. All players skip a turn to party.
card.lore: In our own filth drop our clear judgments.

line: Excessive Wine, Debauchery: skip turn to party; judgments drop in filth.
spokenText: Excessive Wine, Debauchery: skip turn to party; judgments drop in filth.

card.name: Mercutio, The Mongoose
card.power: A Plague on Both Houses. Deal damage to the two strongest players.
card.lore: They have made worms' meat of me.

line: Mercutio, The Mongoose, A Plague on Both Houses: damage strongest; worms' meat.
spokenText: Mercutio, The Mongoose, A Plague on Both Houses: damage strongest; worms' meat.

card.name: Queen Mab, The Bug
card.power: Inception. Plant a false idea (card) in an opponent's hand.
card.lore: She is the fairies' midwife... she gallops night by night through lovers' brains.

line: Queen Mab, The Bug, Inception? False idea in opponent's hand; fairies' midwife.
spokenText: Did you hear of Queen Mab, The Bug, Inception? False idea in opponent's hand; fairies' midwife.

card.name: Dreams
card.power: Illusion. Cancel an attack; it was just a dream.
card.lore: Begot of nothing but vain fantasy.

line: Dreams, Illusion: cancel attack; nothing but vain fantasy.
spokenText: Dreams, Illusion: cancel attack; nothing but vain fantasy.

card.name: The Hazel-Nut Chariot
card.power: Transport. Move a card from the discard pile to your hand.
card.lore: Made by the joiner squirrel or old grub.

line: The Hazel-Nut Chariot, Transport: discarded card to hand; joiner squirrel or old grub.
spokenText: The Hazel-Nut Chariot, Transport: discarded card to hand; joiner squirrel or old grub.

card.name: Exeunt Omnes
card.power: Game Over. The player with the most 'Tragedy' points wins.
card.lore: The rest is silence.

line: Exeunt Omnes, Game Over: most Tragedy points win; rest silence.
spokenText: Welcome to Exeunt Omnes, Game Over: most Tragedy points win; rest silence.

card.name: Exit, Pursued by a Bear
card.power: Sudden Death. Eliminate one player instantly. No save.
card.lore: This is the chase... I am gone for ever.

line: Exit, Pursued by a Bear, Sudden Death: player eliminated; gone for ever.
spokenText: Exit, Pursued by a Bear, Sudden Death: player eliminated; gone for ever.

card.name: The Skull's Song
card.power: Encore. Bring one character back from the dead (Discard pile).
card.lore: That skull had a tongue in it, and could sing once.

line: The Skull's Song, Encore: character back from dead; skull had tongue, could sing.
spokenText: The Skull's Song, Encore: character back from dead; skull had tongue, could sing.

card.name: Uncle FrizzleBob's Approval
card.power: Chaos. Shuffle all hands together and redeal.
card.lore: Stay Fluffy! KayfaBINGO!

line: Uncle FrizzleBob's Approval, Chaos: shuffle all hands, redeal. Kayfabingo!
spokenText: Meanwhile elsewhere, Uncle FrizzleBob's Approval, Chaos: shuffle all hands, redeal. Kayfabingo!
